reply: [{"query": "根据ICH E2A，已上市药品发生的严重且非预期不良反应，向监管机构进行快速报告的时限是多少？", "query_en": "According to ICH E2A, what is the expedited reporting timeframe for serious, unexpected adverse reactions occurring with a marketed medicinal product?", "topic": "上市后产品快速报告时限", "absence_terms": ["marketed product", "post-marketing reporting", "commercially available"], "nearest_clause": {"page": 7, "text": "Fatal or life-threatening, unexpected ADRs occurring in clinical investigations qualify for very rapid reporting."}, "rationale": "文档III.B节明确将7/8日及15日报告时限限定于\"occurring in clinical investigations\"的病例，对已上市（营销）产品的加速报告时限未作规定，而PV人员自然会想在同一份关于快速报告标准的指南中查到该信息。"}, {"query": "若申办者未能在ICH E2A规定的时限内提交快速安全报告，将面临何种监管处罚或制裁？", "query_en": "Under ICH E2A, what regulatory penalties or sanctions apply if a sponsor fails to submit an expedited safety report within the required timeframe?", "topic": "逾期报告的处罚措施", "absence_terms": ["penalty", "sanction", "non-compliance", "enforcement action"], "nearest_clause": {"page": 7, "text": "Regulatory agencies should be notified (e.g., by telephone, facsimile transmission, or in writing) as soon as possible but no later than 7 calendar days after first knowledge by the sponsor that a case qualifies, followed by as complete a report as possible within 8 additional calendar days."}, "rationale": "文档详细规定了快速报告的时限要求，但全文未提及未按时提交时监管机构可采取的处罚或制裁措施，这是PV部门在合规执行层面会关心、但该定义与标准类指南未覆盖的事项。"}]
